content.title: Defining Balance in Design
content.content:
Balance refers to the arrangement of visual elements in a way that creates a sense of stability and harmony. In design, balance can be achieved through various techniques such as symmetry, asymmetry, and radial balance. Symmetric balance involves mirroring elements on either side of a central axis, while asymmetric balance uses uneven distribution of elements to create a dynamic feel. Radial balance, on the other hand, focuses on arranging elements around a central point.

For example, consider a logo with a circular shape containing the brand name and tagline. The circular shape provides a sense of symmetry, while the placement of the brand name and tagline within the circle creates balance through radial balance.

Key Takeaways:
• Balance refers to the arrangement of visual elements in design.
• Balance can be achieved through symmetry, asymmetry, or radial balance.
• Symmetric balance involves mirroring elements on either side of a central axis.
